evidence: Palladium ALD was performed using alternating exposures to Pd(II) hexafluoroacetylacetonate (Pd(hfac)2) and formalin, both obtained from the Aldrich chemical company. ... Ultrahigh purity nitrogen (99.999%) at a mass flow rate of 50 sccm was sent through the bubbler during the Pd(hfac)2 exposures, and was diverted to bypass the bubbler following the Pd(hfac)2 exposures.
